Cc: Elmwood IT <it-support@elmwood.k12.edu>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: FERPA addendum + initial questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Elmwood USD is moving quickly — district counsel asked me to surface two immediate items before we schedule a pilot: a FERPA-specific addendum we can sign and confirmation about where student data would reside (we have state-level residency requirements).

Attached is a short questionnaire from our legal team (Elmwood_DPA_Qs.pdf) with a few targeted questions on subprocessors, data export controls, and audit logging. High level asks:
- Can you confirm you support a written FERPA addendum and sign a district DPA?
- Do you offer an option to restrict data residency to a single US region (us-west)?
- Will you include audit log exports and a certified deletion workflow for pilot data?

If it helps, I can brief counsel on a 30-minute call this week. We’d like to kick off a limited classroom pilot in January if feasible.

Best,
Michelle
Director of Technology Operations
Elmwood Unified School District

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FERPA addendum + initial questions

Michelle — thanks for the clear list and for sending the questionnaire. We can absolutely support a FERPA addendum; I’ve attached our working draft (Redwood_FERPA_Addendum_v0.1.docx) to start the legal conversation.

Quick answers up front:
- FERPA addendum: yes, Redwood can execute a FERPA-focused addendum tied to our DPA; our legal team will review Elmwood’s questionnaire and propose redlines.
- Data residency: we support single-region residency for hosted workloads (we can pin a tenant to us-west with dedicated storage and routing for the pilot).
- Audit logs & deletion: audit log exports are available via our Console; we can set up periodic exports (S3) and provide a documented deletion workflow that triggers per-record TTLs plus a certified deletion report.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-min call with counsel + IT (you, counsel, me, Laura) to walk the addendum and residency constraints — can you do Wed 12/2 at 10am PT?
2) I’ll have Hannah partner with engineering to sketch a data-flow diagram and confirm any required controls for the pilot.

Tentative attachments:
- Redwood_FERPA_Addendum_v0.1.docx (draft addendum)
- redwood-data-flow-diagram.png (working sketch)

If counsel prefers, we can accept Elmwood’s questionnaire responses as a starting point for redlines and track edits in DocuSign.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Strategic Accounts — Education
Redwood Inference
